DESIGN THAT STANDS OUT
Clean lines, confident proportions and distinctive  
details give the Geely EX2 a fresh, playful presence. 
Blending aerodynamic efficiency with fun character,
the result is contemporary, expressive and unmistakably  
electric. From signature lighting to thoughtful interior  
details, the Geely EX2 is designed to be enjoyed up close.

SAY Hi  
TO SPACE WITHOUT 
COMPROMISE
Thoughtfully designed to make everyday life easier,  
the Geely EX2 offers generous room for passengers, 
luggage and everything in between. From the spacious 
cabin to versatile integrated storage, it’s space that  
adapts to how you move.

Step inside the Geely EX2 and discover a cabin designed 
around you. Thoughtful ergonomics, soft-touch materials 
and refined finishes create a space that feels as good 
as it looks - every time you get in.
Set the mood inside the cabin
 
Customisable ambient lighting changes colour to match your 
style or mood, creating a modern and inviting atmosphere for 
every drive – with 256 colours to choose from (Ultra only).
Thoughtful design meets premium comfort 
The cabin is intended to create a welcoming environment for drivers and passengers. 
With intuitive controls and a clean, modern layout, every feature is within easy reach. 
WRAPAROUND CABIN INTERIOR
Wireless phone charging
 
Simply place your phone on the wireless charging pad and let the 
Geely EX2 take care of the rest. No cables. No distractions. Just 
seamless charging while you focus on the road ahead (Ultra only).

Five seat configuration
A true five-seat layout  
ensures that all occupants  
can travel comfortably, 
supported by a flat rear floor 
that improves legroom and 
ease of movement.

including the demister and temperature control.

Lock and unlock doors, or open a window

GEELY = LUCKY
We’re a global automotive group with nearly 40 years of heritage. 
We’ve spent the last 15 years investing in the UK’s automotive industry. 
And we couldn’t be prouder to launch here with the Geely EX2.
It’s the next chapter in a journey built on ambition, growth and a 
commitment to the road ahead. Because while Geely might mean ‘lucky’, 
this isn’t about fortune.
This is about our mission to power progress and move  
people forward with confidence and optimism.
Hi, WE’RE GEELY.
